identityFeatures: Off-white square Tall Hermann with dark projecting timber gallery and steep red gable
Warm stone convent, inward red roof fields, open inner court and small southwest octagonal turret
Large open Western Yard, separate North Yard, restored Stone Hall and perimeter walls

limitations: Approximate current exterior from inspected picture and standard viewer PMTiles; no bespoke survey or exact doorway thresholds.
Original architectural master and recipe preserved; independent derivative fits the working floor, foundations and exterior paving.
White Tall Hermann, timber gallery, steep red gable, inward roof ring, southwest turret, stone hall and yard curtains retained. Openings and component heights are reconstructed.
Viewer terrain supplies lawns. Natural river cliff, moat/river, Ivangorod and navigable interiors outside model scope. No artificial ground cutout.
Three shared material graphs and local opaque glass, no embedded images. Physical-device timing remains pending.

geographic.groundContactBasis: The inspected aerial picture confirms the white tower, timber hoarding, steep red gable, inward red roof ring and small turret. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained site outline set approximate location and river-facing orientation. Convent working floor rises0.8m; foundations extend into the coarse riverbank. Broad lawn geometry is omitted from the derivative so actual viewer terrain supplies the yards; low exterior paving follows coarse ground. Anchor 28.200695255,59.375639522; heading 0.198046850682; standard PMTiles datum 25.698401887691865m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
